_comment: GENERATED by scripts/compute-surah-distance.mjs. Jensen-Shannon distance between surahs' root distributions with a permutation null; read excess over null, not the raw distance. See the script header.
source: Leeds Quranic Arabic Corpus v0.4 (GPL), rooted tokens only

method.distance: sqrt of base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence, range 0..1
method.null: pool both surahs' verses, reassign verses at random with side sizes in verses fixed, 500 draws, mulberry32 seed 20261018
method.lowCountRule: either surah has fewer than 100 rooted tokens
